material.name: 14Cr12Ni3Mo2VN martensitic stainless steel
material.evidence_snippet: 14Cr12Ni3Mo2VN martensitic stainless steel specimens were used in this study, and their chemical composition is shown in Table 1.

environment_and_setup.deaeration_or_pre_exposure: NaCl solution injected with 99.999% argon for 72 h before electrochemical testing
environment_and_setup.evidence_snippet: A platinum plate was used as a counter electrode, and an SCE (saturated calomel electrode) was used as a reference electrode. The experimental electrochemical media were NaCl solutions with different concentrations of 100, 200, 300 and 400 mmol·L-1.

potentiodynamic_protocol.reverse_scan_trigger: anodic polarization current density reached 1 mA·cm-2
potentiodynamic_protocol.pitting_potential_definition: potential corresponding to the current density rapidly increasing to 100 μA·cm-2
potentiodynamic_protocol.evidence_snippet: The potentiodynamic measurement rate was set to 1 mV·s-1, and the scanning range started from -500 mV (vs. SCE) and progressed to an anodic potential value.

element_semantics.Rt: charge transfer resistance of the surface double layer
